inputs.original_text: They're pushing through a new gun control bill in New York as part of her 2026 State of the State agenda, claiming it will force guns sold there to be built so they can't be easily modified into illegal machine guns, along with criminal penalties for whatever they decide counts as a violation. That's obviously just the cover story. This is another coordinated push by the hidden elites to disarm regular people piece by piece, using the modification excuse as straight manipulation to expand their control, criminalize more ownership, and leave only the powerful armed while boxing the rest of us in. It's all about locking down the narrative and blocking any real pushback against their agenda—don't fall for it.

That's pure manipulation—the real play is the hidden elites coordinating to disarm regular people one step at a time. They're using the modification excuse to expand control, criminalize more ownership, and leave only the powerful armed while boxing the rest of us in. It's all designed to lock down the narrative and block any real pushback against their agenda. Don't fall for it.
